itemList.description:
Earth work excavation for pipelines/cables by manual means upto 600 mm trench width as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, filling, ramming and watering etc. complete.
[Measurement: 1 x 150.00 x 0.45 x 0.45 = 30.38 Cum]

Providing PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS 4985:2000 (25mm dia, 10 kg/sqcm & class 5) including lowering into trenches, laying, jointing, testing and commissioning with all lead and lift.
[Measurement: 300.00 m (or 150m x 2)]

Refilling available earth around trenches/pipelines/cables in layers not exceeding 20 cms depth, compacting each layer by ramming after watering with lead upto 50m and lift upto 1.5m.
[Measurement: 1 x 150.00 x 0.45 x 0.45 = 30.38 Cum]

Providing, laying and jointing HDPE pipes conforming to IS 4984-2016 (Grade PE1000-PN6.0 / PE80 PN 6.0, 40 mm dia) including electrofusion welding, hydraulic testing, lead & lift complete.
[Measurement: 100.00 m]

Supply, installing, testing and commissioning COMMON control panel consisting of SFU, phase indicating lamps, analog ammeter & voltmeter, MCB, DOL starter, single phase preventor, dry run protection etc. complete.

Supply and delivery at site brand new best make PVC insulated cable of Flat 3 core (sheathed) of nominal cross sectional area as per IS 694-1990 with ISI mark.
[Measurement: 100.00 m]
Providing Single Phase Submersible Pump Sets of 100mm dia (4 inch) suitable for borewell confirming to IS 8034-2000 (2 HP 20 STAGE) to work site with testing as per instructions.
Labour charges for Erection, Electrification and commissioning of Pump sets, including clamps, borewell caps, cable clips, watertight gland protectors, valves, gauges etc.
Labour charges for erection of outdoor type panel board and meter board units with cement concrete foundation bed, testing and commissioning complete.

Providing and placing on terrace / base polyethylene water storage tank, IS: 12701 marked, with cover and locking arrangement (Capacity: 1000 Ltr / 1 No).
[Rate: Rs. 9.00/Ltr + 12% = Rs. 10.08/Ltr for 1000 Liters]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for foundation works with graded coarse and fine aggregates, superplasticizers, compacted using vibrators, curing complete.
[Calculated Volume = 0.641 Cum]

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cutting, bending, hooking, tying with binding wire complete.
[Quantity = 0.455 Qntl / 45.48 Kg]
